|---|---|

| Property facts | Proposed list price; property type; bedrooms; bathrooms; interior square footage; lot size; year built if you want it stated; verified features/selling themes; and any facts or claims we must avoid. |
| Property destination | The MLS, listing, landing-page, or other verified property link to use. If none exists, say so. |

| Open house and lead handling | If applicable: date/hours; required RSVP fields; private destination for responses (CRM, private dashboard, Google Sheet, etc.); authorized administrator; and follow-up owner/target response time. |
| Assets and brand | Permission to use property photography/video/floor plan; files or links; agent headshot/bio; logo, colors, fonts; social profiles; and any required disclosures. |
| Agent outreach | Available MLS/association/brokerage systems; whether there is a consented CRM list; target markets and agent count; budget; and the sender’s business postal address plus opt-out method. |

I will treat any contact data as private and will not publish or send anything without your final fact check and brokerage approval.
